title: "Insufficient calibration" status for G5 native leads to no readings in xDrip
symptom: During the night the alert for calibrating the sensor on the Dexcom receiver popped up, and the receiver continues to collect readings. The latest Aug 5 nightly for xDrip however stopped collecting readings. There was no alert on the Home screen that a calibration was needed. Only on the System status page "OB1 G5/G6 Collector and Transmitter Status" was there an alert for "insufficient calibration".
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but it is implied that the "insufficient calibration" status causes xDrip to stop showing readings.
fix: Enable the Advanced G5 setting for 'Go on without calibrations' which will allow readings to continue even when calibration is insufficient.
evidence_quote: Can you enable the Advanced G5 setting for `Go on without calibrations` which I think will then allow this.
